summary.text: Arturo Alonso Sandoval (D) represents Oklahoma House District 89 in south Oklahoma City and is Minority Caucus Secretary in the 60th Legislature. His House page describes him as one of the youngest elected officials in the legislature.

paragraphs.text: He grew up on the south side of Oklahoma City, is a first-generation American and the son of immigrant parents from Mexico, and holds a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Oklahoma.
